note: DeKalb County IN publishes zoning districts only through the Schneider Beacon public viewer (Butler's zoning is also viewed there as a Zoning-Butler layer). No public REST service or downloadable file of zoning districts was found. Auburn and Garrett publish static zoning map PDFs/pages only. The county's ArcGIS hub-like service at services2.arcgis.com/IxVN2oUE9EYLSnPE is DeKalb County, Georgia (R-75 zones), not Indiana. Beacon is a Cloudflare-protected proprietary viewer whose terms restrict automated access, so I did not scrape it.
